title: Compassion for Self
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk emphasizes the importance of receiving compassion and self-compassion as a foundation for personal growth and well-being. It suggests that by practicing kindness towards ourselves, we can develop greater resilience, improve our relationships, and cultivate a more positive relationship with ourselves. This approach encourages us to look inward and explore our own patterns of self-criticism and defensiveness, rather than just focusing on helping others, in order to find freedom from suffering and connect with others on a deeper level.
